method.median: median of all 16 batch means per version/case/process
method.paired_round: mean of two baseline batches minus mean of two candidate batches in the same round; 8 differences
method.warmup: not recorded by current harnesses; negative-round rows, if present, stored separately
method.scope: local mass arithmetic or native allocation/release, not full cutting cost or CPU time
method.inference: descriptive measurements only; no significance or causality claim

environment.Backend: IL2CPP; Main Stopwatch elapsed time, not CPU time or complete cut cost.
environment.Baseline: b19ce67a; candidate=current ProvisionalBoxMass; same input per process.
environment.Order: ABBA or BAAB by ORDER_REVERSE; 8 rounds, 1024 calls per batch.
environment.Warmup: one 1024-call batch per version and case; not saved in CSV.

warmup.description: one 1024-call batch per version and case; not saved in CSV.

environment.Metric: Stopwatch elapsed ticks on the calling Main thread; not CPU time or complete cut performance.
environment.Scope: per-cut native bookkeeping allocation plus release only. No worker, bake, meshes, report, arena, or end-to-end cut.
environment.Baseline: b19ce67a PhysicsCutCook: ids/bounds/vertexCounts via real PhysicsCutBlocks.Take<T>; bakeDone via cleared NativeArray<byte>.
environment.Candidate: current PhysicsCutMeshSlot, one cleared NativeArray; all arrays Allocator.Persistent.
environment.Release: IsCreated then Dispose in finally; finally is inside each measured batch on both versions.
environment.Order: ABBA (baseline,candidate,candidate,baseline); 8 rounds per case, 1024 cuts per batch.
environment.Warmup: one full batch per case/version and one empty batch; excluded from CSV.
environment.Calibration: one separate 1024-call empty no-inline batch per round; includes loop/call/Stopwatch overhead; not subtracted.
environment.CSV: 64 measured allocation/release rows plus 16 empty rows; all retained, no outlier removal.
